SummaryWhat the results say

  • The benchmark now separates the strategies. changed_only loses 0.39% of top-1 hits (CI 0.27%–0.57%), all on context-stale targets; fixed_hop loses 0.00%. With the old 865 queries the same comparison showed no difference.
  • fixed_hop (k=2) matches a full re-index at 16.6% of the cost. A smarter strategy has to land between it and changed_only (4.3%).
  • predictive_ml is the cheapest (0.43%) and the least accurate: 5.30% of top-1 hits lost and 20.8% of queries ranked lower. It re-embeds less than even changed_only.
  • The cause is the ground truth: only 26 of 5,152 training labels are positive (0.50%), 25 of them on functions whose own code changed. The model learns that almost nothing is stale.

Label rule: a function is stale (1) if keeping its old vector drops at least one of its own queries out of the top-10. Functions with no query are not labelled. "Modified" means the function's own code changed (AST-normalised).

Same weakness as the old benchmark.

Of 285 labelled functions whose code changed in the training pairs, only 25 (8.8%) are labelled stale, and only 1 label in training marks a function stale through context alone. Positives are 0.50% of labels, so a classifier has very little to learn from. Coverage improved (5,152 of 5,816 function-pairs labelled) because of the new queries plus the synthetic supplement.

Query setNew change-focused queries

2,155 queries for 431 functions, built from docstrings or written descriptions, paraphrased, leak-checked against every version of the function, and kept only if an independent model (bge-base) scores them ≥ 0.8 against their source. 3,027 low-fidelity paraphrases were rejected.

CaveatsRead before quoting

  • Stale gains are large for predictive_ml (475 at k=5): some queries still match older versions of their functions better than the current one. They are reported, never credited.
  • 271 functions had no docstring; their descriptions were written by Claude from the code (black_entity_descriptions.json). They are independent of MiniLM but should be stated in the method.
  • One window and one seed. Run n_seeds > 1 for spread across windows before claiming differences beyond changed_only vs. fixed_hop.
  • The benchmark folder holds ~2 GB because raw vectors are stored (store_raw_vectors is on).
